'''Koyi Mateil''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] socialite<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the<ref name="DB" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]<ref name="DB" /> who [[Coruscanti/Legends|lived]] on<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the last [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Mateil was the [[Marriage/Legends|consort]] of [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Teta (duke)/Legends|Teta]]<ref name="DB" /> and was often in his company despite the difference in their ages. She secretly schemed to steal Teta's [[Currency/Legends|wealth]]<ref name="CSWE" /> and abscond should he [[Death/Legends|die]].<ref name="DB" /> 

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the Twi'lek attended a performance of<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> the ballet ''[[Squid Lake/Legends|Squid Lake]]''<ref name="ROTS IS">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref> at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]]<ref name="ROTS" /> in Coruscant's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]].<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> She walked up the stairs of the building with Teta as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ran up the stairs past them to meet up with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] inside.<ref name="ROTS" /> Mateil had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], light skin, and artificially dyed [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] meant to make her skin tone appear more [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="CSWE" /> She wore a silver [[Clothing/Legends|headpiece]] and an evening dress with a beaded bodice.<ref name="DaG">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Koyi Mateil was first mentioned by "Culture Lover," a behind-the-scenes photograph by [[Keith Hamshere]] displayed in the [[Before the Helmet]] feature in [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club]], which released on [[January 13]], [[2005]].<ref name="Before the Helmet">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/bth/2005/01/bth20050113.html|series=Before the Helmet|text=Culture Lover}}</ref> She then appeared in the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> on [[May 19]] of that same year.<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> Mateil was portrayed by an uncredited extra<ref name="ROTS" /> in scenes filmed at [[Shepperton Studios]] as part of additional photography on [[August 23]], [[2004]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Mateil was incorrectly identified as "[[Koyi Komad]],"<ref name="DaG" /> a different ''[[Star Wars]]'' character,<ref name="Komad">{{CSWECite|II|224|Komad, Koyi}}</ref> in the photo costume gallery in the rear of the book ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'' by [[Trisha Biggar]],<ref name="DaG" /> which released on [[October 11]], 2005.<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archivedate=20260701041521}}</ref>
